connector.name: Gcs
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Google Cloud Storage with fine-grained tool access control.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gcs-google-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to service account key JSON file.

env.name: GCS_BUCKET
env.description: Constrain all operations to a single bucket (hides bucket-level tools).

env.name: GCS_ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable (readonly, readwrite, delete).

env.name: GCS_ENABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of specific tools to enable (overrides groups).

env.name: GCS_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of specific tools to disable.
